Designed to meet HDMI 2.1 specifications, they deliver up to 48Gbps of bandwidth, supporting 8K at 60Hz and 4K at 120Hz with HDR for lifelike brightness, contrast, and color. Advanced features such as Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM), and Enhanced Audio Return Channel (eARC) ensure a seamless home theater and next-gen gaming experience.The slim, flexible design makes these cables easy to route in tight spaces while maintaining the durability needed for everyday use. Featuring a CL2 flame-retardant jacket, they are safe for in-wall installations and comply with residential building code requirements for clean and professional setups. Gold-plated connectors resist corrosion and preserve signal integrity, while multi-layer shielding protects against electromagnetic interference.
